title: Study revisions can be reused after deletion
evidence: Save week revision 1; delete; recreate (revision 1); stale PUT revision 1 overwrites the new 20-minute report with 99 minutes.
acceptance: Keep non-reusable revision tokens across delete/recreate; reject stale writes/deletes; retain backup compatibility.
resolution: Persisted monotonic revision floor survives deletion; restore issues fresh tokens. Regression rejects stale PUT/DELETE after recreate and stale PUT after restore; 56 Python tests pass. Real browser conflict retains the draft and saved data.

title: Settings initialization fails
evidence: wire() calls $('[data-mode]').forEach: querySelector returns an element. Real browser shows load-failed toast; mode and language buttons have null handlers.
acceptance: Bind both mode buttons through querySelectorAll; test actual mode/language/settings interactions in both locales.
resolution: Corrected querySelectorAll bindings; Settings/Reports no longer fetch unrelated examination analytics, and Quick rendering only runs on the Quick view. HTML is no-store with content-versioned assets. Settings regression passes 16 empty/populated × locale × theme × viewport configurations, three Quick/Advanced cycles each, real language switches and injected analytics failures; no workspace-load errors. Python verifies asset versions/cache policy.

title: Browser-server launch accepts foreign Host and Origin writes
evidence: Disposable TestClient POST with unrelated Host/Origin returns 201. DesktopSession has protection, but plain uvicorn app does not.
acceptance: Reject non-loopback hosts and cross-origin requests before processing bodies; preserve desktop and local CLI access.
resolution: Trusted loopback Host middleware plus same-origin and cross-site-write rejection run before body processing. Tests cover rejected foreign/null origins and hosts, accepted same-origin writes and local IPv4/IPv6 reads; source desktop smoke passes.

title: Exam exports ignore active filters
evidence: /api/exams?from_date=2026-10-01 returns 1 fixture; /api/export/json with same query returns 2. UI links omit all filters while report copy claims shared scope.
acceptance: Apply validated date/subject/search scope to JSON and CSV and include it in UI links; test matching counts and invalid ranges.
resolution: JSON/CSV endpoints and UI links share validated date, subject and search scope. API regression verifies counts/content and invalid dates; actual filtered browser downloads match displayed exam records.

title: Exam CSV emits spreadsheet formulas
evidence: A title '=1+1' exports as an executable formula cell. Study CSV already neutralizes formula-like text.
acceptance: Use a shared spreadsheet-safe text helper; preserve numeric negative scores; test all text columns and both languages.
resolution: Exam and study exports reuse export_utils.safe_cell. Formula-like text is neutralized while numeric negative scores remain numeric; English/Persian CSV regression passes.

title: Restore validation is weaker than normal writes
evidence: Backup preference correct_weight='1e200' restores successfully, then new exam POST returns 422. Study backup validation also omits write-time name/description/order/detail limits.
acceptance: Use equivalent preference and study-field validation before replacement; invalid backup leaves live data unchanged.
resolution: Restore now enforces the normal preference and study metadata domains. Corrupt weight, counter, category order, activity label, revision and control-character backups are rejected without changing live fixtures.

title: Real subject names collide with missing-value placeholders
evidence: One unassigned exam and one explicitly named 'Unassigned' are merged into one subject with count 2. Topic groups also concatenate names using an ambiguous ' / ' separator.
acceptance: Group by structured identities, represent missing labels separately, and test placeholder/delimiter collisions without mistranslating user labels.
resolution: Missing subjects use null identity; topics use structured tuple keys. Four distinct placeholder/delimiter cases remain four groups in subject, topic and heatmap output. Presentation no longer translates real user labels named Unassigned.

title: Exam deletion failures are unhandled
evidence: The async detail-delete click handler has no catch or pending-state guard. A rejected DELETE escapes the UI error flow.
acceptance: Guard repeated deletion, show localized failure, retain dialog and record on failure, and test offline/404 paths.
resolution: Guarded async deletion disables repeat submission, catches failure, retains the dialog and restores the button. Node failure/concurrent-click regression passes.

title: Unsaved exam drafts are lost on navigation and display changes
evidence: Quick form values live only in DOM; load() replaces #app after theme/language/navigation. No capture or discard confirmation exists. Study navigation retains its draft, but reload/tab close does not.
acceptance: Retain exam drafts across intentional UI refreshes or ask before discard; protect dirty page departure for both modules.
resolution: Dirty exam forms ask before closing, navigation or display changes; cancelled confirmation retains input. beforeunload protects both exam and study drafts. Node confirmation tests and real browser edit/Quick theme/reload flows pass.

title: Desktop smoke test fails on valid 204; error logging then fails
evidence: Actual source desktop smoke exits 1: JSONDecodeError decoding empty DELETE response, then FileNotFoundError reopening a log inside the deleted temporary profile.
acceptance: Handle empty/204 responses, detach closed logging handlers, and run source smoke successfully without logging errors.
resolution: Empty response bodies bypass JSON decoding; the file logging handler is detached before closing. Actual source smoke returns ok:true for assets, scoring, CRUD and analytics (desktop-after.json). Frozen study/PDF verification remains R27.

title: Exam edits have no stale-write protection
evidence: Full edit form PATCH contains old fields; storage merges those over the latest record without checking updated_at/revision, so a second editor can overwrite newer metadata.
acceptance: Add backwards-compatible revision/ETag workflow with stale-edit feedback and retained drafts; verify two-client edits.
resolution: Version-4 UUID revision snapshots reject stale PATCH requests with 409; successful edits and restores issue new tokens. Application submits the revision; legacy API clients may omit it. Python two-client/restore regression and browser conflict test confirm saved data and the unsaved draft survive.

title: Duplicate category labels share an ECharts legend identity
evidence: Category names are editable and need not be unique; stacked series use name for ECharts legend selection, so identically named categories cannot be independently toggled.
acceptance: Give duplicate display names distinct, understandable legend labels and test independent visibility in each locale.
resolution: Duplicate chart labels include localized group and category identity. Node tests and actual ECharts legendUnSelect interactions in English/Persian confirm each duplicate category toggles independently.

title: Dedicated examination PDF report is absent
evidence: Exam Print invokes window.print() on report-control cards; no prepared examination analytics report. Weekly Study PDFs are implemented and separate.
acceptance: Generate localized scoped exam reports with metadata, summaries and charts; visually verify English and Persian PDFs.
resolution: Prepared scoped English/Persian exam PDF includes summary, chronological chart, embedded local font and full metadata. Actual browser downloads and frozen export tests pass. Rendered three-page documents were visually checked; Persian chart dates and percent formatting corrected.

title: Examination Excel export is absent
evidence: Only exam JSON/CSV endpoints exist. Weekly Study Excel export is implemented.
acceptance: Add scoped exam XLSX with numeric values, summaries, localized labels and formula-safe text.
resolution: Scoped XLSX contains numeric scores, full metadata, localized sheets/headings, summary and chart; text cells are formula-safe. Python opens and asserts workbook values/scope; browser and frozen downloads pass.

title: CSV import and complete exam CSV round-trip are absent
evidence: Import accepts JSON only; exam CSV omits weights, start/end times and timestamps.
acceptance: Define a versioned CSV schema, validate preview/commit atomically, preserve historical scoring configuration.
resolution: Version-1 CSV carries saved weights, tags, timing and timestamps, accepts English/Persian export headings and reversibly escapes formula-like text. Import uses existing atomic validation/preview pipeline. Round-trip, invalid-row rollback and snapshot preservation tests pass.

title: Start/end times cannot be entered or derived in UI
evidence: Storage validates HH:MM but forms omit start/end controls; automatic duration and overnight policy are not implemented.
acceptance: Expose timing controls, define overnight behavior, retain explicit duration, and test consistent edits.
resolution: Advanced entry exposes start/end times; explicit duration takes precedence, otherwise duration derives with an earlier end treated as next day and equal times as zero. Python tests and browser 23:45–00:30 save assert 45 minutes.

title: Subject/topic management is missing
evidence: Lookup creation and subject listing exist, but no inspect/rename/unused-cleanup UI or API.
acceptance: Implement referenced-safe management; preserve exam associations and prevent accidental cascades.
resolution: Settings manages subjects/topics through referenced-safe APIs. Renames preserve identity and invalidate affected exam revisions; only unused records can be removed, with no cascades. Python relation/deletion tests and real browser rename workflow pass.

title: Configurable unanswered weight is missing
evidence: Unanswered questions always contribute zero; no per-exam unanswered-weight snapshot or setting exists.
acceptance: Add validated migration and central scorer support; keep historical zero-weight results unchanged.
resolution: Version-4 migration adds zero-default saved unanswered weight without changing old results. Settings/new records and central preview/save/simulation calculations use the snapshot. Python verifies bounds, saved scores, changed defaults and hypothetical gains; browser saves negative unanswered points correctly.

title: Selected-exam comparison is missing
evidence: Selected-period comparison exists, but there is no selection of individual exams/attempts for side-by-side comparison.
acceptance: Add selectable records/attempt comparison using saved scoring configurations.
resolution: History selects 2–6 attempts for side-by-side comparison of saved results, question counts and all marking weights. Selection persists across pages. Browser verifies two selected records and complete dialog columns; accessibility audit passes.

title: Detail dialog omits stored metadata
evidence: Current dialog shows date, subject, result, raw/max, correct/incorrect and notes; total/unanswered, topic, tags, attempt, timing, weights and timestamps are absent.
acceptance: Show all stored fields accessibly with localized labels, optional-field empty states and mobile layout.
resolution: Detail dialog includes total/unanswered, topic/type, tags, attempt, timing, all weights and timestamps with localized labels and bidirectional isolation. Browser asserts all 14 supplemental metadata fields, responsive dialog behavior and safe edit navigation.

title: Long study category names break page width
evidence: Valid 100-character name produced document width 1461 at viewport 929; mobile also overflows.
acceptance: Constrain grid children and wrap user labels in entry, category manager, report and statistics; test 390/768/1440 in both languages.
resolution: Constrained grid children and enabled wrapping for user category labels. Fresh browser matrix checks 100-character English/Persian names in entries, management, statistics and saved report dialogs at 390/768/1440 pixels in both themes; representative screenshots visually inspected.

title: Exam detail close icon differs from the icon system
evidence: showDetails renders a literal multiplication sign while other dialogs use the shared SVG close icon.
acceptance: Use the same SVG and localized accessible name; verify focus and hit target.
resolution: Detail close uses the shared SVG icon with existing localized accessible name. Browser confirms SVG presence; keyboard regression verifies Escape and focus restoration in 12 configurations.

title: All-history reads and per-record queries remain unbounded
evidence: Exam list loads tags once per exam; study list issues multiple queries per week; frontend fetches all exams plus analytics for most views.
acceptance: Measure realistic large fixtures, batch related reads, paginate history and keep summary calculations independent of page size.
resolution: Exam tags are batched (two SELECTs per page); study entries/details are batched (three SELECTs for all weeks). History uses 50-row pages while metrics use all filtered records; invalid page offsets reset after filtering/deletion. Benchmark: 10,000 exams/1,000 weeks, page ~0.009s, study reads ~0.009s, full analytics ~0.383s on this host. Query-count regression and populated/empty browser pagination checks pass.

title: No coherent clean-environment lock; TestClient deprecation remains
evidence: 50 tests pass with Starlette/httpx deprecation. Runtime ranges and Windows pins differ; clean install not verified this review.
acceptance: Test a fresh environment, choose compatible test client dependencies and record/pin the verified set.
resolution: Fresh Python 3.12 environment installed exact manifests plus transitive Windows constraints; compatible httpx2 removes the old TestClient warning. pip check and all 67 Python tests pass. npm lock pins browser/lint tooling. Installation mirror workaround and platform scope are recorded in current validation.

title: Dense source and duplicated translation assignments obscure defects
evidence: Large functions are single lines; translation keys are overwritten later; the Settings selector error passed syntax/unit checks.
acceptance: Format and modularize incrementally, centralize resources, add linting and behavior-level regressions.
resolution: Formatted all first-party JavaScript/CSS, consolidated translations into one resource, extracted workflow helpers and added ESLint/Prettier checks. Both locales have matching nonempty keys. All 25 Node tests, lint and real Settings/control regressions pass.

title: CI omits study Node tests, calendar drift and browser workflows
evidence: Workflow invokes only three old Node suites; no browser or study-PDF verification step. Existing unit suite did not exercise Settings binding.
acceptance: Run all Node suites, calendar checks and isolated browser workflows; assert control behavior, not just absence of console errors.
resolution: Windows workflow now includes all five Node suites, lint, calendar drift, isolated three-browser/Settings workflows and rendered exam/study PDF checks before frozen build. These commands pass locally; no remote CI dispatch or publication is claimed.

title: Packaged Weekly Study/PDF behavior is unverified
evidence: Build smoke checks exam paths only; no current frozen binary with study exports and Playwright driver was tested. This is an unverified boundary, not a proven packaging failure.
acceptance: When release work resumes, build in clean Windows environment and verify native UI, study persistence, downloads and PDF browser discovery.
resolution: Built frozen Windows executable from the fresh pinned environment with bundled Playwright driver. HTTP smoke passes study persistence plus English/Persian exam/study PDF/XLSX downloads using installed Edge. Native WebView2 tests pass RTL/font/chart/report behavior; a second run sees the saved 210-minute record. Local verification only; GitHub publication remains paused.

title: TODO and delivery docs contain stale/conflicting claims
evidence: Checked items retain defect text; latest counts say 35 while baseline is 50; Windows docs imply a published download; README calls editable facts immutable and suggests SQLite-to-PostgreSQL is a URL change.
acceptance: Publish one canonical current checklist, archive old reports, distinguish exam/study reports and pending Windows release, remove architecture overclaims.
resolution: Archived prior checklists/review; root TODO.md is canonical and outputs/TODO.md points to it. Current report distinguishes fixes, missing features and verification gaps. README/Windows/release notes now identify unpublished release state, editable exam facts, actual PostgreSQL migration effort and exam-versus-study reporting scope.

title: Legacy exam constraints/migration pipeline need strengthening
evidence: Exam schema does not enforce integer SQLite storage types, weight/duration domains or derived-score invariants directly; initialize inserts v1/v2 markers and executes CREATE statements. Supported writes are validated.
acceptance: Introduce forward migrations with preflight validation and rollback tests; do not silently rewrite saved scores. Direct SQL is outside normal supported writes.
resolution: Transactional version-4 migration preflights historical domains, adds scoring snapshot/revision fields and installs SQLite insert/update guards without recalculating saved scores. Regression injects a DDL failure and confirms rollback of columns/version marker; direct inconsistent scores/counts/durations are rejected. Legacy backup/migration tests pass.

title: Study PDF masks every failure as a missing browser
evidence: Any exception, including font/rendering/data errors, becomes studyPdfUnavailable with an install-browser instruction.
acceptance: Distinguish browser installation errors from unexpected generation failures; log diagnostics and show appropriate bilingual feedback.
resolution: Shared PDF renderer classifies absent-browser launch separately (503/setup message). Unexpected rendering failures return localized reportFailed (500) and log diagnostics. Injected missing-browser/render-fault tests pass for both study and exam exports; real PDFs generate in source and frozen builds.

title: JSON import ignores declared schema version
evidence: import_json validates exams shape but never payload.version; unsupported future versions are accepted and unknown fields ignored.
acceptance: Accept documented legacy/current formats; reject unsupported declared versions before preview or writes.
resolution: Declared JSON schema versions must be integer 1; unsupported versions fail before preview or mutation. Versionless legacy payload remains supported. Regression passes.

title: Formal accessibility and cross-browser coverage remains incomplete
evidence: Existing checks cover Chromium DOM/keyboard semantics and screenshots; no screen-reader audit, Firefox/WebKit run or automated contrast baseline.
acceptance: Add targeted assistive-technology/cross-browser/contrast coverage and record concrete failures separately from untested areas.
resolution: Targeted accessibility/contrast and accessibility-tree coverage added across 48 Edge/Chromium, Firefox and WebKit configurations. Dashboard, Settings, Study and comparison dialog have zero axe WCAG A/AA violations in that matrix. Fixed muted/negative light-theme contrast; checked keyboard dialogs and named controls. Human NVDA/JAWS certification is outside these automated checks and is not claimed.

title: Timeline tooltip fails when actual-result series is hidden
evidence: The formatter reads date/title from the first visible series datum. Moving-average data is numeric; hiding actual results produces undefined dates (or an empty tooltip for zero).
acceptance: Use timeline identity by dataIndex and format each visible series; test moving-average-only and zero values.
resolution: Tooltip resolves examination identity by timeline dataIndex and lists visible series values. Node regression covers moving-average-only legend state and zero values.

title: Mixed-direction chart-data labels reorder date components
evidence: Current English heatmap data-table screenshot shows a Persian subject adjacent to the Gregorian day reordered (4 before the subject, followed by Sept 2026). The label concatenates subject, date and sample count into one unisolated text run.
acceptance: Isolate subject/date/count components in accessible chart rows and tooltips; verify mixed Persian/Latin labels in LTR and RTL without reversing date tokens.
resolution: Accessible chart rows isolate subject/date/count with FSI/PDI and tooltips use bdi; saved labels remain unchanged. Node tests assert individual isolation, bilingual browser rendering passes, and mixed-script screenshots/PDFs were inspected.
